plugin.name: LibraryMapper
plugin.creator: Chris / NSP-0123456
plugin.desc: Map your large music library inside Lyrion: browse a virtual Genre\Artist\Year-Album layout with temporal (albums added recently) and quality (hi-res/CD/lossy) filters, simplify hundreds of raw genre tags into a few broad groups, and consolidate album artists - all without touching a single file on disk. Albums are filed under a single canonical artist name (spellings are merged, "Last, First" and lower case are normalized), while a collaboration such as "A & B" is filed under each of its artists. The artists are then filed alphabetically under their last name when they are a person ("Claude Nougaro" under N) and under the name they carry when they are a group ("Metallica" under M, "Miles Davis Quintet" under M, the ensemble word being skipped); the names written in Cyrillic, Hebrew, Japanese or Chinese are transliterated so that they are not left after the "z". A regular expression narrows the artist list down. A list of trusted names can be uploaded on the parameter page: those are always one single album artist and are never split. Includes an initialization phase, mapping validation and download/upload of mapping files from the plugin parameter page.
plugin.changes: 0.4.0 - the browse node is registered with the server, so "Simplified View" appears in My Music (every skin, Material included). The artists are filed under their last name (a person) or under the name they carry (a group), the ensemble word is skipped, and the names that are not written in Latin letters are transliterated. A regular expression filter on the artist list, a list of trusted single-artist names that are uploaded on the parameter page, and the download/upload of the mapping file. 0.1.0 - first version.
